high_level_description: The image is a graphic design related to the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. Here's a detailed description: Background: The background consists of horizontal stripes alternating between pink and navy blue. This color scheme is reminiscent of the French flag, which features similar colors. Central Design: At the center of the image is a stylized, circular logo. Inside the circle, there is an abstract representation of a face with closed eyes and a serene expression. The face is composed of two main colors: pink and navy blue, mirroring the background stripes. The design is minimalist and modern.
